newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA ASKS BOARD PRESIDENT TO STAY ON.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA ASKS BOARD PRESIDENT TO STAY ON.

text.p: The president of the board of
control for cricket in Sri Lanka, the one-day world champions,
has been asked to stay on, the sports ministry said on Friday.
Board president Upali Dharmadasa sent a letter of
resignation to Sports Minister S. B. Dissanayake on Thursday
over a breach of protocol at the Singer world series final
Dissanayake was invited as chief guest at last Saturday's
ceremony but was not called on to present the awards after the
final in which Sri Lanka beat Australia.
The awards were made by the chairman of Singer in Sri Lanka,
The sports ministry said in a statement that Dissanayake,
who had demanded an explanation from Dharmadasa, asked the board
In his resignation letter, Dharmadasa wrote: "I apologise
most profusely on behalf of the board of control for cricket and
myself for the embarrassment caused to you, both as an
honourable Minister of State and as a person."
